cues.text: A host-desecration narrative from 1370 gave rise to a long-venerated Brussels devotion known as the 'Sacrament of Miracle.'
⚠ Note for editor: this account is historically tied to anti-Jewish persecution.
The Archdiocese of Mechelen-Brussels formally distanced itself from the traditional narrative in 1968 — handle with particular historical care in the full article.
